Elecevolve RT-880X Review: Coming Soon

Hands-on review coming soon
Share:hqshortwaveradio.com/reviews/elecevolve-rt-880x/

A pocket DSP receiver built on NXP's TEF6686 tuner chip, with a 320×240 color touchscreen, air band, RDS and LW/MW/SW/FM coverage. It's open for pre-order at $69, and my hands-on review is in progress.

$69 pre-order (regular $75)
Pre-order directly from Elecevolve.
Pre-order at Elecevolve →

What I'm testing

  • Shortwave band scans with real stations logged by frequency, time and distance from Arizona
  • MW (AM broadcast) DX: built-in ferrite antenna vs. an external antenna on the SMA input
  • Air band from Phoenix-Mesa Gateway tower, 11 miles away
  • FM and RDS: station names and RadioText on local and distant stations
  • Whether it handles SSB, which is not listed on Elecevolve's spec sheet
  • Touchscreen usability, menus and battery life
  • Head-to-head with the Elecevolve MLite-880

Specifications (from the manufacturer)

Receiver chip: NXP TEF6686 DSP tuner
FM: 65–108 MHz (adjustable regional limits), plus OIRT
LW: 144–513 kHz
MW: 522–1791 kHz (9 kHz steps) or 520–1720 kHz (10 kHz steps)
SW: 1.7–27 MHz
Air band: 118–137 MHz (25 kHz default step)
Display: 320 × 240 color touchscreen
Antenna: Built-in ferrite (MW) or SMA external antenna input
Memories: 198 station memories, DX scanning and DX logging
Extras: RDS, bandwidth control, iMS/EQ and noise processing, clock with NTP/RDS time sync, 22 languages, 14 themes
Build: Aluminum alloy top and bottom panels

The hands-on review is in progress. It will be published on this page, at this same address, with band scans, logged stations and a full verdict.

How much does the Elecevolve RT-880X cost?

$69 pre-order (regular $75), according to the manufacturer's store.

What bands does the Elecevolve RT-880X receive?

Per the manufacturer: FM 65–108 MHz (adjustable regional limits), plus OIRT; LW 144–513 kHz; MW 522–1791 kHz (9 kHz steps) or 520–1720 kHz (10 kHz steps); SW 1.7–27 MHz; Air band 118–137 MHz (25 kHz default step).

Does the Elecevolve RT-880X receive SSB?

SSB is not listed on the manufacturer's spec sheet. I will test it and report the result in the review.
